thread:
alex: quick flag — ran overnight quant sweep for the new 'verdant-lite' candidate. overall perplexity and BLEU look fine, but we see p95 latency regressions on short chat turns. need to slot this for bring-up or push to low priority. who can +1 a quick risk triage?
maria: can you paste the perf numbers and the exact config?
alex: sgd-quant-4bit, kernel=custom_qk, batch=1/8 mix. summary: p50=38ms, p95=312ms for 1-4 token prompts on T4s. For longer prompts p95 aligns with baseline. weird spike on very short inputs.
jasper: that pattern hints at overhead in kernel startup or KV path. did you try warm prefix caching?
alex: yes — with prefix cache warm p95 drops to ~120ms but still >baseline's 85ms. also tried continuous batching (window=20ms) and that masks some spikes but increases p50 for single-turn.
sophia: sounds like tradeoff: keep latency SLO for short interactive flows vs unit cost. product asked for sub-100ms p95 for interactive route.
liam: how critical is this model for roadmap? if it's a quality win (lower logprob tail) might be worth a dedicated slot or canary on Dedicated with reserved GPUs.
maria: propose we score it using quick rubric: (1) user-impact (3) (2) quality delta (2) (3) infra risk (2) (4) cost delta (1) -> total out of 8. alex, can you fill those?
alex: user-impact=3 (improves hallucination rate on our eval set), quality=2, infra risk=2 (kernel path changes), cost delta=1 (slightly cheaper tokens). total=8/8. leaning high priority but needs risk mitigation plan.
jasper: mitigation checklist (quick):
```
- smoke deploy to staging (dedicated GPU pool)
- run latency heatmap across prompt lengths (1,2,5,20,200 tokens)
- run PSL-based quality suite vs golden prompts
- test prefix cache behavior on cold/warm starts
- compare kernel variant: custom_qk vs baseline_qk
- quantify cost per 1M tokens with batching profiles
```
sophia: assign action items? I can own the heatmap/metrics dashboard and set the alerts.
alex: assigning: jasper owns smoke deploy + kernel toggle. maria owns PSL quality runs. liam please validate capacity for a canary slot and cost projection.
liam: I can carve a 2-GPU canary in Dedicated for 48h (estimate cost +10% baseline). Will post infra ticket.
maria: quick note: eval-bot posted nightly diffs — small regression on summarization slice but improvements on code generation. attaching snippet below (from eval-bot):
eval-bot: nightly/diff: {'summarize_long': -0.8, 'code_completion': +2.3, 'hallucination_rate': -1.5} (sigma)
sophia: given the mixed quality signal, suggest canary + A/B with fallback to baseline model on error/latency exceed. If canary fails SLO -> auto-fallback.
alex: agreed. can we add a rapid rollback checklist? minimal: 1) disable traffic routing, 2) drain KV caches, 3) restore baseline model version, 4) verify p95 back to baseline, 5) roll metrics snapshot to snapshot-store.
jasper: I'll add the kernel toggle flag so we can flip to baseline_qk without redeploy. also will instrument tracing for kernel_entry and kv_miss.
liam: infra ticket: INF-6421 — provisioning 2xA10 dedicated canary for 48h. link: https://redwood.internal/infra/INF-6421
maria: timeline? prefer to run canary tomorrow morning US-PST to hit peak traffic for samples.
alex: timeline +1 — I can coordinate canary start at 09:00 PST. final approvals? @sophia?
sophia: +1 from me for canary and auto-fallback. make sure marketing/product are aware of short window.
alex: thanks everyone. i'll drop a condensed runbook in the canary ticket and follow up with a short retrospective once we have results. :thumbsup:
